description: This pie chart illustrates the proportional distribution of sixteen labeled categories. The segments are visually ordered in descending size in a clockwise direction, beginning from the top right. The largest slice is green and lacks a visible text label, instead containing a small grey rectangular box, visually accounting for just under 20% of the total area. Continuing clockwise, the subsequent slices are labeled as follows: a light blue slice for "from" (17.00%), a yellow-orange slice for "to" (14.50%), a dark green slice for "genre" (13.50%), a dark blue slice for "name" (5.20%), a brown slice for "size" (4.20%), a light green slice for "time" (4.10%), a light blue slice for "intent" (3.80%), a yellow slice for "location" (3.80%), a dark green slice for "destination" (3.00%), a blue slice for "city" (2.60%), an orange-brown slice for "class" (2.40%), a light green slice for "range" (2.20%), a light blue slice for "type" (2.00%), a yellow slice for "beds" (1.30%), and finally, the smallest dark green slice for "passengers" (1.10%). The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, labels and percentages are placed directly inside or overlapping the larger segments (from "from" to "intent"), while the labels for the smaller segments (from "location" to "passengers") are positioned outside the pie and connected to their respective slices with thin grey leader lines. None of the slices are exploded, offset, or otherwise visually emphasized.
